Package com.thalesgroup.gemalto.d1.digitalcard.stepup

Class StepUpAuthenticationDetails

java.lang.Object
com.thalesgroup.gemalto.d1.digitalcard.stepup.StepUpAuthenticationDetails
public final class StepUpAuthenticationDetails extends Object
Details extracted from step-up verification payload.

This class contains information needed to perform step-up authentication for digital card operations such as provisioning, device binding, and cardholder verification.

Since:
4.6.0
